content: सर्वथा {%ind.%} .²1 In every way, by all means; सर्वथा व्यवहर्तव्यं कुतो ह्यवचनीयता <ls>U. 1. 5</ls>. .²2 At all, altogether (usually with negation). .²3 Completely, entirely, utterly. .²4 At all times. .²5 Exceedingly, very much. .²6 In whatever way; सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते <ls>Bg. 13. 23</ls>.
